query: INSERT INTO tabac_molecule_links (tabac_id, molecule_id, concentration, notes, created_at) SELECT t.id, m.id, 0.9, 'Compose phenolique majeur du Latakia fume', NOW() FROM tabacs t, molecules m WHERE t.name LIKE '%Latakia%' AND m.name LIKE '%guaiacol%' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes); INSERT INTO tabac_molecule_links (tabac_id, molecule_id, concentration, notes, created_at) SELECT t.id, m.id, 0.8, 'Derive phenolique du fumage', NOW() FROM tabacs t, molecules m WHERE t.name LIKE '%Latakia%' AND m.name LIKE '%creosol%' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes);
